H=W=21
out=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
seeds={3:[(0,14),(3,17),(5,9),(6,10),(6,13),(8,15),(8,17)],6:[(2,3),(17,3)],1:[(2,7),(17,7)],7:[(2,6)],4:[(3,2)],8:[(13,10),(15,16),(17,13)]}
for color,pts in seeds.items():
    for r,c in pts: out[r][c]=color

def line(a,b,color):
    r,c=a; R,C=b
    dr=0 if R==r else (1 if R>r else -1)
    dc=0 if C==c else (1 if C>c else -1)
    assert (r==R or c==C or abs(R-r)==abs(C-c)), (a,b)
    n=max(abs(R-r),abs(C-c))
    for i in range(n+1): out[r+dr*i][c+dc*i]=color
poly3=[(0,14),(3,17),(8,17),(8,15),(6,13),(6,10),(5,9)]
for i,p in enumerate(poly3): line(p,poly3[(i+1)%len(poly3)],3)

line((2,7),(17,7),1)
